text.tspan: If we organize the sample space by the number of times tails occurred, we can calculate the

no tails occur, so the probability that is . There are 4 different ways where one tail occurs, so the
probability that is . The rest of the probabilities are computed in the same way.

Note that each of the numbers listed in the probability column are between 0 and 1, and that the sum
of all the probabilities is equal to 1. The column for
lists the number of tails you might get out of
4 coin flips, which could be any whole number between 0 and 4.
